sn10.8:1.1: This story, which tells of the conversion of the Buddha’s chief layman follower, is also found in the Vinaya at [pli-tv-kd16:4.1.1]().
sn10.8:2.1: The commentary expands this number to 100,000, but the Chinese parallels at SA 592 and SA2 186 prefer the more modest and literal figure of 100.
sn10.8:2.5: BB’s “step” for padavitihara is incorrect, it is a special term denoting a “great stride forward” for which “stride” alone is barely adequate. He has adopted “stride” in AN.
